cohort: Singleton and twin pregnancies at the Medical University of Vienna over an 11-year period (2003-2013) with a gestational age between 23 and 42 weeks
finding: The main contributors to the cesarean delivery rate were Robson class 5 (previous cesarean delivery), class 2 (labor induction or prelabor cesarean delivery), and class 8 (multiple gestation).
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was highest in Robson class 5 (previous cesarean delivery) at 99.1%.
